tagline: Slow bread and small batches, on Chapel Road since 2014.
description: A neighbourhood bakery on Chapel Road, Bandra: sourdough, croissants, cookies and celebration cakes, baked in small batches every morning.

pages.description: Sourdough, croissants, cookies and celebration cakes, baked in small batches every morning on Chapel Road, Bandra. Order for delivery or pick-up.

sections.headline: Bread worth *waking up* for
sections.lede: Sourdough fermented for two days, croissants with twenty-seven layers, and cookies still warm at 11. Baked in small batches, every morning.

items.title: Out of the oven at 7 am
Ten years *old*
items.text: Our sourdough starter is fed twice a day with stone-ground wheat from Madhya Pradesh.

items.title: 48 hours in the *cold*
items.text: Dough rests for two days. That is where the flavour — and the easy digestion — comes from.

items.title: No premixes
items.text: Flour, water, salt, butter, time. If we can't pronounce it, it's not in the bread.

items.title: Eggless on request
items.text: Most cakes and cookies can be made eggless — just tell us when you order.

items.title: Delivered by 1 pm
items.text: Order by 9 pm and we deliver in Bandra, Khar and Santacruz the next morning.

sections.title: Let's design your *cake*
sections.text: Book a free 30-minute chat at the bakery or on a call. We'll sketch it together and send you a quote the same day.

items.a: Three to four days wrapped in a cloth. Slice and freeze it after that — it toasts beautifully from frozen.

items.q: Do you make eggless or vegan bakes?
items.a: Most cakes and cookies can be made eggless. Our sourdough, focaccia and pav are vegan.

items.q: How much notice do you need for a cake?
items.a: Three days for most cakes, a week for tiered or sculpted ones.
